data.name: Create Agent (Agents API - Beta)
data.description:
Create a reusable, versioned agent configuration for Claude Managed Agents (Beta).
Documentation: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview
Quick Start:
- POST an agent configuration to /v1/agents. Required headers include x-api-key and anthropic-version. Beta/Admin access may be required.
Parameters Explained:
- name (required) — Agent name.
- configuration (required) — Agent configuration object (instructions, tools, resources, versions).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request for invalid agent configuration JSON.
- 401/403 for missing or insufficient credentials.
Edge Cases:
- Agents are versioned; creating an agent may produce a version identifier.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Agents and Sessions endpoints share the 32 MB request limit and are subject to Beta constraints.
data.evaluateGuide: Creates a reusable, versioned agent configuration through the agents endpoint. Use it to define an agent and its configuration payload.\nUse for: create an agent, define agent instructions, configure agent tools, version an agent\nNot supported: running an agent, sending chat messages, retrieving agent versions

data.name: List on-prem agents
data.description:
Retrieves a list of all on-prem agents in a customer workspace.
Documentation: https://docs.workato.com/en/oem/oem-api/on-prem.html#list-on-prem-agents
Quick Start:
- Provide managedUserId and issue a GET with a bearer token.
Parameters Explained:
- managedUserId (required, path): Embedded customer workspace ID/external ID.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid token.
- 404 Not Found: managedUserId not found.
Edge Cases:
- Response state values may vary (e.g., awaiting_setup, connected).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- 60 requests per minute for On-prem endpoints.
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves on-premises agents associated with a managed customer account. Use it to inspect agent availability and connection state.\nUse for: list on-premises agents, check connection states, inspect managed agents, verify agent setup\nNot supported: creating agents, updating agent configuration, connecting an agent
